propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map silently truncate at 50 issues due to unpaginated search_issues calls, causing issues beyond the first page to be omitted from maps
search_issues uses a default max_results=50 parameter, and Jira DC silently caps pages below the requested size, making it impossible for callers to distinguish between truncation and completion
three separate methods (get_parent_map, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) each implement their own pagination logic, creating repeated instances of the same defect
a shared _paged_search helper must be created that advances by len(batch) and terminates only on empty pages, then routed through all three whole-project readers
get_parent_map already contains the correct paging implementation but must be refactored to use the shared helper to prevent future drift and establish the canonical pattern
